newsitem.title: USA: Continental sets S. America business class.
newsitem.headline: Continental sets S. America business class.

text.p: Continental Airlines will inaugurate "BusinessFirst" business-class flights to South America, beginning Wednesday.

Continental's new premium-cabin service will be launched from New York/Newark to Rio de Janeiro, and Sao Paulo, Brazil; Lima, Peru; Quito, Ecuador; and Bogota, Colombia; and from Houston to Lima, Peru.
Continental said it is the second largest U.S. carrier to South America, based on the number of destinations, serving 19 countries and 32 markets in Latin America and the Caribbean.
